children: ICICI Securities research report on Chalet Hotels

Chalet Hotels (CHALET) has evolved from a pure-play asset owner into a hybrid model with the launch of its Athiva premium lifestyle brand in FY26. With CHALET’s operational hotel portfolio poised to increase by 1,655 keys to over 5,000 keys by Mar’30 (based on its expansion plans), alongside its leasing traction, we estimate 15%/20% revenue/EBITDA CAGRs over FY26–29E (excluding residential). Annual post-interest OCF of over INR 10bn from FY27E could support incremental capex of INR 30bn between FY26–29E.
We retain BUY with an unchanged SoTP-based TP of INR 1,095, based on 22x Mar’28E hotel EV/EBITDA. Brownfield/greenfield additions could provide a further fillip to earnings.
